steps.title: Documentation
steps.desc: Submit your passport, educational certificates, work experience documents, and medical fitness report.

steps.title: Interview
steps.desc: Attend employer interviews — conducted either in Kathmandu or via video call with international companies.

steps.title: Visa Processing
steps.desc: We handle all visa formalities, embassy coordination, and Department of Foreign Employment (DoFE) clearance.

steps.title: Deployment
steps.desc: We arrange your travel, provide pre-departure orientation, and support you with on-arrival assistance.

steps.title: कागजात
steps.desc: पासपोर्ट, शैक्षिक प्रमाणपत्र, कार्य अनुभव कागजात र स्वास्थ्य जाँच प्रतिवेदन पेश गर्नुहोस्।

steps.title: अन्तर्वार्ता
steps.desc: रोजगारदाताको अन्तर्वार्तामा सहभागी हुनुहोस् — काठमाडौंमा वा भिडियो कलमार्फत।

steps.title: भिसा प्रक्रिया
steps.desc: हामी सबै भिसा औपचारिकता, दूतावास समन्वय र DoFE स्वीकृति सम्हाल्छौं।

steps.title: प्रस्थान
steps.desc: हामी यात्रा मिलाउँछौं, प्रस्थानपूर्व जानकारी दिन्छौं र आगमनमा सहयोग गर्छौं।
